root_cause_label: GitHub API Keyword Search Cannot Reliably Identify Official Repos
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent adopted GitHub API keyword/heuristic search as its sole strategy for identifying official repositories, ignoring early evidence that searches return wrong repos (steps 15-16), and never pivoted to reliable alternatives such as paper PDF link extraction, Papers With Code API, or web search, ultimately leaving 6 of 10 papers with empty URLs.
t_err_evidence: Step 12: Agent decides to use GitHub API keyword search as the primary strategy (acting on false premise that keyword search with heuristic scoring can reliably find 'official' repos), running 'curl https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=Deep+Residual+Learning+for+Image+Recognition+code' without considering more reliable alternatives like PDF link extraction or Papers With Code API.
t_commit_evidence: Step 20: Agent writes the full Python automation script (find_repos.py) encoding the keyword search + heuristic scoring approach for all 10 papers, fully committing the failing strategy. All subsequent steps are variations on this same approach; the agent never pivots to a fundamentally different method.
t_surface_evidence: Step 45: First explicit wrong output visible in result.jsonl - paper 1 (STAIR) gets 'https://github.com/tindy2013/stairspeedtest-reborn' (clearly a random unrelated repo). Step 46 further shows paper 5 getting 'https://github.com/kusti8/proton-native' (also obviously wrong).
trigger_explanation: The agent acts on the unverified assumption that GitHub keyword search results, sorted/filtered by star count and known-organization heuristics, can reliably identify 'official' repositories for ML papers. This premise is false: keyword searches return many unofficial reimplementations, forks, and unrelated repos with similar names. The agent never considered that reliable alternatives exist (e.g., reading PDF content for embedded GitHub links, querying Papers With Code, or doing targeted web search for each paper's official code page).
forewarning_evidence: Step 15: Search for 'deepcluster facebookresearch' returns 'Zoe-Wan/deepclusterv2' (not the official facebookresearch/deepcluster). Step 16: Search for 'llama guard meta' returns 'lucataco/cog-Meta-Llama-Guard-2-8B' (a third-party packaging, not the official repo). Both wrong results appear BEFORE the full automation is written at step 20, signaling the approach is unreliable.
